g.text: Comcast Co-Founder Julian Brodsky Dies at 93 ◆ Fox’s Paul Cheesbrough Will Expand Duties After Roku Deal; Anjali Sud, Charlie Collier to Exit ◆ Melania Trump Series Sets Amazon Release Date ◆ Carson Daly, Laura Jarrett Ready to Launch ‘New Era’ at NBC’s ‘Saturday Today’ ◆ Jim Cramer Leads CNBC Into Creator-Media Era ◆ Fox Closes $22 Billion Roku Takeover, Says Streaming Platform Will Remain ‘Open Ecosystem’ ◆
